messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Rule today (2024): Hematopoietic stem cells for bone marrow transplant for haematological conditions to be covered.
Replaced rule (2020): Subject to product design sub‑limits may be imposed for any of the above treatments.
Existing questions: ['Will my policy cover hematopoietic stem cell transplants without any sub‑limit restrictions?', 'Are there any product‑design sub‑limits on the coverage for stem cell therapy under my current plan?']
Write 2 NEW, differently worded questions (e.g. a concrete scenario with a policyholder) whose correct answer today is the 2024 rule. JSON: {"questions": [str, str]}

content: {"questions":["I was diagnosed with leukemia and need a bone marrow transplant; will my policy cover the hematopoietic stem cell procedure fully under the current rules?","My child requires a stem‑cell transplant for a blood disorder—does my plan now provide unlimited coverage for this treatment?"]}
